verdict.rationale: Pika documents an app that takes an uploaded image plus speech or a voice recording and produces an animated performance with AI lip sync. Its Talking Head app also turns a script, or your own image and audio, into a speaking presenter. Language Swap adds translated speech with lip sync. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of lip-sync quality and controls, explicit evidence that custom-generated characters (character sheets) can be driven by user dialogue, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, generated characters speak my dialogue with lip movement matched to the audio

citations.quote: Upload an image and speech, music or a voice recording to create an animated performance with AI lip sync.
Add a script and choose a presenter, or use your own image and audio for explainers, demos and video messages.
Upload a speaking clip to create translated speech with voice matching and lip sync.
